Focus areas

Bioeconomy and Circular Economy

We transform waste and biological resources into economic, energetic and environmental value through processes of use, recovery, bioinputs, fermentation, biomass and circularity.

Select a service to know its function, objective, restrictions and general mathematical formulation.

Services

Characterization, classification and traceability of waste

Function: identify origin, quantity, composition, quality and destination of each stream.

Aim: maximize correct separation and recoverable information.

Restrictions: cross contamination, safety, sampling, storage, regulations and variability.

Use plans and circular economy

Function: assign to each stream a prevention, reuse, recycling or recovery route.

Aim: maximize recovered value and reduce final disposal.

Restrictions: mass balance, quality, demand, logistics, waste hierarchy and cost.

Vermiculture and development of HidroEcoCaja systems

Function: transform compatible organic fractions through a controlled biological process.

Aim: obtain stable and traceable products with low odor operation.

Restrictions: permitted materials, humidity, temperature, aeration, load, safety and capacity.

Research on bioinputs and bioremediators

Function: formulate and validate biological products for a defined application.

Aim: reduce the target pollutant or recover soil functions.

Restrictions: identity, concentration, purity, stability, toxicity, dosage, efficacy and regulation.

Biomass valorization and biohydrogen routes

Function: evaluate biomass and organic waste as raw materials for biological or thermochemical processes.

Aim: maximize useful product per unit of matter and energy.

Restrictions: composition, humidity, biodegradability, contaminants, pretreatment, safety and emissions.

Evaluation of materials, currents and life cycle

Function: compare alternatives from extraction to end of life.

Aim: minimize impacts for the same service unit.

Restrictions: equivalent limits, data quality, shelf life, maintenance, transportation and disposal.
